CML Auctioneers are delighted to present this outstanding detached bungalow set on approximately 7.676 acres of prime lands in one of Mullingar's most desirable residential locations. Combining a spacious family residence, excellent equestrian facilities, extensive grounds and a self-contained two-bedroom apartment, this exceptional property offers an enviable country lifestyle with outstanding versatility and income potential.

Located just 6km from Mullingar town, Ballyboy enjoys the perfect balance of peaceful rural living and convenient access to schools, shops, sporting facilities and major transport routes. The location is highly sought after, making this a superb opportunity for families, equestrian enthusiasts, hobby farmers or purchasers seeking multi-generational accommodation.

The main residence extends to a bright and well-appointed three-bedroom bungalow featuring two generous reception rooms, a spacious kitchen/dining area, utility room, family bathroom and en-suite master bedroom. New PVC double glazed windows and doors, fibre broadband availability, pumped cavity walls and attic insulation further enhance the comfort and efficiency of the home.

A standout feature of this property is the impressive c.7.676-acre holding, offering tremendous scope for equestrian, agricultural or recreational use. The lands are complemented by three substantial stables, a large garage and a polytunnel, making the property ideally suited to those with horses, livestock or lifestyle farming interests.

Adding exceptional value is the independent two-bedroom apartment, complete with its own entrance, open-plan kitchen/living accommodation, pellet stove, shower room and spacious first-floor bedroom with walk-in wardrobe. Whether utilised for extended family, guest accommodation or as a potential rental opportunity (subject to any necessary consents), this versatile unit significantly enhances the appeal and investment potential of the property.
